metadata.description: GLUE MRPC (Microsoft Research Paraphrase Corpus) for MinHash near-duplicate detection evaluation. Sentence pairs labeled 1=paraphrase (near-duplicate, high lexical overlap) or 0=non-paraphrase.
metadata.source: nyu-mll/glue config=mrpc (Dolan & Brockett 2005; GLUE benchmark Wang et al. 2019)
metadata.relevance: Paraphrase pairs share high n-gram overlap — direct MinHash/Jaccard evaluation signal
